book.title: Wicked: The Grimmerie
book.description: Like Harry Potter, Wicked the musical seems to invite lame metaphors about casting spells and magic. Certainly, this play about pre-Dorothy Oz has enthralled audiences from Broadway to San Francisco and Los Angeles. The musical, based loosely on Gregory Maguire's novel, tells the story of Elphaba, the headstrong "Green Girl" and the good witch Glinda. This full-color pictorial offers an extended behind-the-curtains peek at the musical, its casts and creators. Wicked: The Grimmerie, which is packaged to resemble a book of spells, contains the show's libretto, a witchy illustrated family tree, and a step-by-step look at how Elphaba becomes green before each performance.
